info.description: Lab 5 deployment (Gateway 28080, Broker 28601, Discovery 28500). FIRST run scripts/lab4-prepare-postman.py and import its PRIVATE environment. Run folders in order. Regenerate fixtures before repeating a collection. All requests assert their expected status. Removed service-only Gateway routes deliberately expect 404. Native gRPC examples: postman/grpc/README.md. Never export real environment credentials into Git.

request.description: Expected 200. Current release fails: Crafting requests Player profile with a service identity (403) and World /api/v1/wings?lobby_id=... (404; current World API is /api/v1/worlds/{lobbyId}/wings with player auth). Keep this assertion failing until the service integration is fixed; do not treat 403/404 as success.
